repos_data.description: A lightweight, cloud-native GIS platform for visualizing, exploring, and analyzing geospatial data. It runs in the web browser, on the desktop, on mobile, and inside Jupyter notebooks.
☁️ 轻量级高性能跨平台AI对话 + AI Agent + AI网关桌面客户端 | Lightweight, high-performance cross-platform AI dialogue + AI Agent + AI gateway desktop client

Native macOS & Windows Google Gemini desktop client, chat backup and conversation exporter. Sync and archive all chat history, attachments, Deep Research, Canvas and AI-generated media locally as JSON.
